newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers Russia $30 mln under GSM-102 in FY97.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers Russia $30 mln under GSM-102 in FY97.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Wednesday authorized $30 million in credit guarantees for sales of U.S. farm goods to Russia under the Export Credit Guarantee Program for fiscal year 1997.

USDA said the commodities covered include cotton, animal feed products, breeder livestock, dairy products, feed grains, fresh, frozen, and canned vegetables and fruit, frozen orange juice concentrate, meat, oilseeds, wheat, vegetable oil and rice.
